user.title: Welcome: connect your inverter
user.description:
Choose your battery connection: SMA STP SE or an existing Huawei Solar integration. Configure the connection and operating mode in the following steps.

Warning: With write access enabled, Opti Akku actively controls battery charging and discharging. Incorrect settings or errors may cause additional electricity costs, unintended operation or damage. Follow the manufacturer’s requirements and disable other writing controllers before enabling write access. Shadow mode remains strictly read-only.

data.shadow_mode: Read-only shadow mode (cannot be disabled later)

huawei_device.title: Select Huawei Solar device
huawei_device.description: Select the battery inverter of a loaded Huawei Solar entry. Shadow stays permanently read-only. For future control choose a standard entry; its write access also starts disabled.

huawei_sources.title: Map Huawei Solar measurements
huawei_sources.description: Map fresh Huawei measurements to the battery inverter. Capacity may be Wh or kWh; select the grid-power sign explicitly. Configure additional generators under plant and sources.

sources.title: System and measurements
sources.description: Native plant balance is recommended for new SMA installations and requires confirmation that the grid meter covers all selected loads and generators. Select additional inverter AC outputs, never DC strings. Select whole-home consumption in W or kW where needed. Optional PV sources override SMA measurements. External house consumption must be an unsmoothed total. Excluded loads affect the forecast profile independently of EV locking. Legacy preserves the previous calculation for imports and existing entries. The minimum applies only to the forecast. Balance mode uses native AC power; an alternative hybrid AC source is not allowed in this mode.

data.single_inverter: Calculate house consumption from this single inverter
data.plant_meter_confirmed: The grid meter covers all selected generators and loads

battery.title: Battery and power limits
battery.description: Set charge-level limits and maximum charge/discharge power from your battery specifications or previous controller. These are strategy limits, not verified hardware protection. Capacity and temperature are read automatically.

tariff.title: Electricity tariff
tariff.description: Tibber uses dated prices from your existing HA integration. Confirm your home and euro tariff in the next step. For other providers, select both price entities; today/tomorrow must contain complete intervals with start, end and timezone. For operation without price optimization, choose Entities and leave both price fields empty.

data_description.ladepreis: -1 means no reference charging price is known yet. Existing saved values are retained during upgrades.

forecast.title: PV forecast
forecast.description: Select all three forecast sensors in kWh or Wh. Solcast and Forecast.Solar need compatible source sensors; provider sign-in is not configured here. Leave all three empty to skip forecasts; predictive reserve planning is then limited. Optimism blends available conservative and normal estimates.

data.opti_prognose_netzladen: Allow reserve planning with grid charging

ev.title: EV charging: evcc connection (optional)
ev.description: For evcc loadpoints. Select both mode and charging status. While charging in now or minpv mode, home battery discharge can be blocked; battery charging remains allowed. Without an EV charger, leave sources empty and the block off. To remove this feature, clear all sources and turn the block off.

balancing.title: Balancing (optional)
balancing.description: Optional. Interval 0 disables all balancing planning. When planning is enabled, cell spread may trigger additional demand. Grid charging needs separate permission. New entries do not import counters from previous automations; existing integration counters are preserved. The cell-spread source is optional and can be removed.

finish.title: Review and save

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Fine tuning; defaults are suitable for getting started. Source ages are checked in seconds. Short limits may treat unchanged sources as missing. Apply changes using Review and save.

features.title: Optional features
features.description: Select only the features you need. Without selection, EV discharge blocking and balancing planning stay off. Configure them later under Configure → Optional features.

migration_review.title: Review migration

data.accept: Accept displayed valid values into the draft

migration_mapping.title: Map legacy helpers
migration_mapping.description: Empty fields are not imported. Submit captures a new snapshot for review. Units are not converted.

tibber.title: Connect Tibber
tibber.description: Uses your existing Tibber login in Home Assistant, without another token or helper. Currently supports exactly one Tibber account with one home. Current price and planning use the same dated series. The HA action does not report a currency: explicitly confirm that your Tibber tariff is billed in EUR/kWh. Cancel this step for other currencies.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Probleme erscheinen immer als Home-Assistant-Meldung. Optional zusätzlich einen vorhandenen Push-Dienst auswählen. Der Testknopf auf der Geräteseite prüft die Zustellung. Während HA selbst ausfällt, kann die Integration nicht alarmieren.

huawei_controls.title: Map Huawei controls
huawei_controls.description:
Map existing Huawei Solar controls for the battery inverter. Mode, excess PV and forced status must belong to the same Batteries device. Missing controls may require enabling parameter configuration in Huawei Solar.

The extra AC-generator option depends on your plant and defaults off.

Warning: writes actively control your battery. Schedules and power limits can persist through HA failure. Disabling attempts a pause; it does not restore the previous configuration automatically. Disable other controllers and verify a recovery path before activation. Write access starts disabled. An unconfirmed pause is saved and retried on reconnection only with the same device binding and single-writer confirmation.

demand.title: Demand profile and peak reserve
demand.description: The night/PV forecast remains observational. Optionally use comparable historical or learned hourly loads for the active peak reserve, with a 20% forecast margin and configured fallback load. This changes battery control. Heating and hot water are included in the household profile; future cycles are not scheduled. Unknown heat context or detected unquantified hot-water demand retains the fallback. Separate heat-meter mode is not yet supported for the active peak profile.

data.enabled: Learn demand profile and observe forecast
data.heat_power: Heat pump total electrical power, included in house consumption
data.dhw_due: Hot water expected before PV (optional demand signal)
data.dhw_cycle_kwh: Measured electrical energy per hot water cycle (0 = unknown)
data.context_water_temperature: Actual hot water temperature (context and demand check)
data.context_water_target: Target hot water temperature (context and demand check)
data.use_for_peak_reserve: Use hourly profile for active peak reserve

observation.title: Observe measurement sources
observation.description: Read-only: active house source stays unchanged. Match the grid connection, additional inverters and excluded loads. HA report timestamps are not proof of a new device measurement. Compare our time-weighted 60-minute value with legacy smoothing; interpolation can differ.

data.instant_house: Unsmoothed house load excluding selected loads

ev_preparation.title: PV preparation for the car
ev_preparation.description: Prepare the home battery using PV surplus when vehicle SOC is low, including while away. No additional grid charging. While the car charges, ordinary home charging/discharging pauses; priority protection charging is retained. Vehicle SOC expires after 24h; unknown charging state blocks preparation. Automatic strategy only; no arrival prediction. While automatic car preparation is enabled, minimum discharge power is always set to 0 W, even without current charging demand. This prevents forced export; normal battery supply to the house remains possible.
